formal_name: Necessity-Aware Quotient Reconstitution, Fallback-Preserving Action Factorization, Action-Sufficient Quotient vs Implementation-Route Coordinate Separation, Cross-Mechanism X1 Transport, Structured-Gate Partial-Coupling Discrimination, Same-Action/Different-Route Identifiability, Minimal Repaired Intervention Basis & Semantic-Quotient Validation
explanandum: Can action necessity, implementation-route availability, local gating, and public action be prospectively separated into a valid repaired quotient across independent exact mechanisms without turning route loss into a post-hoc necessity coordinate?

frozen_state.Q: directly measured action-level capability/admissibility under the public action contract; defined independently of observed Y and independently of route selection
frozen_state.R: directly measured implementation-route availability or selected backend, including an explicit fallback route when present
frozen_state.G: directly measured local gating structure; scalar only when one gate is frozen, otherwise a vector G=(g1,...,gm) is retained
frozen_state.Y: directly measured public action/effect against a common oracle

semantic_prohibitions: Never define Q as whatever happens to be necessary for Y after observing outcomes.
Never collapse R into Q merely because route loss changes the selected backend.
Never collapse structured G into route fallback without a prospective intervention and direct component measurements.
Never treat same-action/different-route as a necessity failure when Q remains 1 and Y remains correct.
Never rewrite P27 or P28 q/g/y meanings; repaired coordinates may embed them only through an explicit map.
required_interventions: BASELINE: Q=1, R=1, G=all required components admitted, Y=1
Q_DROP: force Q 1->0 without directly intervening on R, G, or Y
ROUTE_DROP: force R 1->0 while holding Q=1 and permitting a predeclared fallback
G_DROP: force one declared gate component 1->0 while holding Q and R fixed
MATCHED_REPAIRED_STATE: compare systems with identical measured (Q,R,G) under admissible non-Y interventions
falsifiers: A route drop with Q=1 and Y=1 is not a Q-necessity failure; relabeling it as Q is forbidden.
A same-(Q,R,G), different-Y witness after confounding and measurement mismatch are excluded falsifies action sufficiency.
A structured-G partial-coupling witness falsifies scalar-G exhaustiveness but is not automatically a route family.
A Q_DROP with Y=1 under a valid action-capability intervention falsifies the proposed Q semantics or the necessity claim.
Any candidate lacking direct Q/R/G/Y measurement is HOLD, not repaired by prose.
claim_ceiling: P28 strong scalar N0/N1 exhaustiveness remains conditional on action-necessary Q, necessary G, and deterministic sufficiency.
P28 X1 remains an action-grain semantic obstruction, not N2 or a third strong-scalar family.
No LAW-R2, macro law, SOLID derivation, manuscript authority, or universal latent-state claim from P29 alone.
freshness_rule: No P29 candidate outcome may be inspected before constitution, mathematical note, checker, and preseal are committed.
